purpose: Extraction audit only; no retrieval rankings or outcomes used.
normalization: Matches root metrics: NFKC, remove hyphen followed by optional whitespace/newline/whitespace, collapse whitespace, trim, lowercase. Markup-normalized and compact-character checks are diagnostics only, never scoring substitutions.
limitations: Full-markdown matching is document-wide; page-specific original gold was validated separately with pypdf.
Compact-character presence diagnoses recoverable spacing/punctuation damage but does not prove correct table structure or semantic preservation.
Missing-or-reordered-text requires manual inspection; this label does not distinguish all glyph, ordering or extraction defects.
Single-passage oracle requirements can underestimate valid support assembled from multiple returned passages.
Negatives have no positive spans; this audit does not score abstention.
